name: Now playing
author: WinDock
description: The current media session (Spotify, a browser, the Media Player app ...): album art, title and artist. Previous / play-pause / next over the face while hovered, always, or as buttons beside it; a long title or artist scrolls; middle-click for a popup with the controls; the wheel changes the volume and shows a volume bar beside the dock (a setting). On the desktop it can be a mini player instead: Deck, Capsule, Cover or Disc, in the dock theme's colours, Silver or Night, with progress (click or drag to seek) and a volume slider.

settings.label: Show the title and artist beside the art
settings.description: Horizontal docks only; a vertical dock shows the art.

settings.label: Text width (DIPs)
settings.description: How much room the title and artist get beside the art on a top or bottom dock. Default: 120.

settings.label: Previous / play-pause / next

choices.label: Over the face while the pointer is over it
Beside it: previous on the left, next on the right

settings.description: Beside it: the widget grows by two buttons (above and below the art on a left or right dock); play / pause shows over the art while hovered and as a small badge otherwise.

settings.label: Scroll a title or artist that does not fit

choices.label: While the pointer is over it
Always (while the dock is on screen)

settings.description: Never with reduce motion. Always costs 10 - 30 wake-ups a second (by the speed) while a line is too long and the dock is shown.

settings.label: Scrolling speed
settings.description: How fast a title or artist that does not fit scrolls. Default: 28.

settings.label: The wheel changes the volume (with a volume bar)
settings.description: Turning the mouse wheel over the widget changes the volume and shows a volume bar beside the dock. On by default.

settings.label: Layout on the desktop

choices.label: Deck: art, display, transport and volume in a bar
Capsule: a pill with the art as a disc
Cover: large art over the display and controls
Disc: the art as a disc with a progress ring

settings.description: Used only while the widget is on the desktop by itself (a standalone widget); on a dock it is always the tile. Picking a layout gives the window that layout's size; the player then scales with the window.

choices.label: Dock theme (its panel, text and accent colours)
Silver (brushed metal with a blue display)

settings.label: Accent colour
settings.description: The progress, the volume slider and (Silver, Night) the play button. Transparent (#00000000): the skin's own.

settings.label: Show the progress
settings.description: The position in the track (the Disc: a ring round its rim), redrawn once a second while something plays. Click or drag on it to jump, when the playing app allows that.

settings.label: Show the volume slider
settings.description: Deck and Cover only (the others change the volume with the wheel).
